title: Deep sludge dewatering enhanced by biochar skeletons from different sources: performance comparison and mechanistic insights
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,698-712
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00718F, Paper
Pengchong Wen, Yunfan Bao, Pengyu Liu, Zheng Ge
Multi-source biochar skeletons from anaerobic sludge, surplus sludge, and rice husks enhance sludge permeability and enable deep dewatering by providing structural support and adsorbing EPS.
